approval_required_for: A bounded external environment-recovery/replay authorization for the exact immutable board source fingerprint, only after the planned hash-bound provenance report demonstrates a single authorized tool/profile/export binding.

consumes: remote job stage-pruning, cleanup, and prelaunch environment logs
hashes and complete source closure for the exact user-supplied wrapper and simulation sources
current Vivado export facts and current tool-profile executable authorization
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep board verification blocked. Do not edit RTL, wrapper, harness, manifest, monitor, numeric policy, checkpoint, stimulus, or expected outputs, and do not launch an unchanged-source VCS replay. Record the unresolved provenance result against the active board SACG barriers and return to this action after the capability implementation gap is corrected.
produces: repair_execution/first_source_attributed_diagnostic.json or explicit proof that none exists
executable_actions.rationale: A required multi-agent-system capability is missing: planned_tool.vcs_compile_diagnostic_source_provenance must perform a read-only audit that binds the current exact-board identity, user-supplied wrapper/source closure, Vivado exports, tool profile, ordered remote VCS commands, remote stage-pruning/cleanup logs, and the returncode=125 event. It must produce an explicit decision on whether the immutable source fingerprint may undergo environment recovery without any source, manifest, monitor, testbench, or observability edit. This is checker/golden-reference infrastructure repair, not hardware correctness.

consumes: immutable exact-board source and wrapper hash inventory
active SACG barriers contamination_barrier.0329 through contamination_barrier.0353 and retry_request.0136 through retry_request.0144
executable_actions.on_failure: If authorization is denied, ambiguous, lacks a single hash-bound identity/tool-profile binding, or permits any source/manifest/numeric-policy change, deny replay and keep the board layer blocked. Do not infer compile commands, wrapper names, or tool executables.
produces: SACG note preserving active barriers and retry requests pending Stage7 rerun
executable_actions.rationale: The existing evidence authorizes neither a replay nor a source repair. A bounded approval is required only after the provenance report unambiguously identifies the immutable exact-board closure and a recovery path. The authorization must be limited to restoring the external execution environment; it may not waive identity binding, alter sources, or loosen semantic comparison requirements.

consumes: repair_execution/exact_board_environment_recovery_authorization.json with approved immutable source fingerprint and recovery scope

immutable board semantic-reference bundle: complete Transformer-block checkpoint tensor catalog, target-model reference execution, input stimulus provenance, frozen numeric policy, generated semantic-testbench hashes, and DUT complete-scope weight-binding requirements
exact user-supplied board wrapper and simulation source hash closure
current Vivado export facts, tool-profile authorization, and canonical ordered VCS compile plan
executable_actions.on_failure: If the static identity gate fails, stop before VCS and return the new hash-bound discrepancy to repair.board_vcs_prelaunch_provenance. If VCS runs but fails, use its current trace and first source-attributed diagnostic to localize the earliest board wrapper/runtime causal boundary; repair only that current-layer slice under the immutable semantic contract. Create a targeted lower-layer backtrack request only if a current trace directly contradicts a named lower-layer certificate with direct core-start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and certificate evidence. Never change tolerance or derive expected outputs from DUT/random data. If all checks pass, rerun Stage7 and let SACG reconciliation—not this action—decide whether active barriers and retry requests may be superseded.
produces: verification/semantic_evidence/board_axi_ddr.json only after all prerequisite board checks pass
current reports for multilayer functional, pipeline deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR image roundtrip, and board semantic evidence
SACG current-layer outcome and retry/barrier reconciliation candidate; no backend promotion artifact
executable_actions.rationale: Only after the explicit provenance decision and environment-recovery authorization permit it, rerun the failed board layer using the exact user-supplied wrapper and immutable semantic contract. This first obtains the required current-layer execution/trace evidence; it does not reopen passed leaf or connected-kernel scopes.

observations: The deterministic conditional router returned no_split; there is no specialist result to supersede the evidence-based repair decision.

real_tool.case_axi_ddr_interface failed before simulation because simulation.source_identity_sha256, compile_authority, ordered-command authority_refs, and simulator executable authorization do not bind the current exact-board identity, Vivado export facts, and tool profile. This is a verification-capability/provenance failure, not an RTL failure.

case_vcs_functional_sim, case_vcs_evidence_analyzer, and case_deadlock_axi_check are not current executable evidence because case_axi_ddr_interface blocked them. The supplied VCS diagnosis is explicitly historical_only and cannot justify a replay or source repair.

Prior repair execution additionally records remote returncode=125 before VCS launch, no source-attributed compiler diagnostic, source_semantic_repair_eligible=false, and an explicit prohibition on unchanged-source replay until hash-bound remote prelaunch provenance and environment-recovery authorization are produced.

Live hash-bound operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates remain reusable. No current board trace has direct core-start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and certificate evidence contradicting a lower-layer invariant; therefore neither leaf modules nor the elastic variable-latency connected kernel may be reopened.

No board-level functional, numeric, data-order, complete-weight-consumption, AXI, DDR, liveness, lifecycle-frontier, or output claim exists. The missing board semantic-evidence report is downstream of the blocked board execution, not evidence that expected outputs may be generated from RTL or random data.

sacg_memory_truth has 16 active scope-matched contamination barriers and open retry requests retry_request.0136, retry_request.0140, retry_request.0141, retry_request.0142, retry_request.0143, and retry_request.0144. Their rejected artifacts remain planning/debug evidence only; no relevant open backtrack request exists. Without a retry-reconciliation contract and successful current-stage checks, none may be closed or treated as a promotion waiver.

All retry work must preserve the exact user-supplied wrapper and simulation-source hashes, complete target-checkpoint tensor catalog, deterministic/real stimulus provenance, target-model expected outputs, bound loader/harness weight-consumption proof, generated semantic-testbench hashes, and frozen numeric comparison policy. Transformer-block outputs remain the DUT golden boundary; embedding/tokenization and model-tail operations are excluded.
proposed_actions: Implement and run a read-only, hash-bound remote VCS prelaunch provenance capability before any replay or source edit.
Obtain a narrowly scoped approval decision for external environment recovery only if the provenance report identifies an exact immutable source closure and a tool-profile-authorized recovery path.

After approval, rerun the board layer in dependency order with the exact wrapper and immutable semantic bundle; localize any real failure at the earliest current board boundary and keep lower-layer certificates closed unless directly contradicted.
risks: The candidate repair workflow's direct unchanged-source remote VCS replay conflicts with the recorded prelaunch-provenance prohibition and could repeatedly produce unactionable returncode=125 evidence.

Identity disagreement across the reported source fingerprints, exact-board identity document, Vivado export contexts, ordered VCS commands, executable authorization, source/include/library closure, and remote cleanup environment can invalidate any apparent compile or simulation result.

Until a real board run occurs, model/shape/numeric/data-order/memory/runtime/implementation/board consistency is unproven. In particular, no board result currently proves that all required Transformer-block weights were consumed or that target-model outputs were compared under the immutable tolerance.

Changing atol, rtol, max_mismatch_fraction, checkpoint, stimulus, target reference, testbench contract, wrapper closure, or expected-output source to obtain a run would contaminate the repair loop and is prohibited.

A later output-frontier or lifecycle-frontier symptom alone must not be attributed to the certified kernel: independent AXI or prefetch progress is not output/lifecycle progress, and any lower-layer reopen requires a current hash-bound contradiction.

The active SACG barriers and retry requests block downstream consumption and promotion even if a partial recovery action succeeds; only a full current Stage7 rerun and SACG reconciliation can establish a promotable board result.
output.summary: Fail closed at the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system layer. The earliest executable failure is the current board simulation identity/compile-authority contract failure in case_axi_ddr_interface; real VCS simulation was dependency-skipped. The proposed unchanged-source VCS replay is not authorized because prior repair execution requires a hash-bound prelaunch provenance decision and environment-recovery authorization first. No RTL, testbench, manifest, monitor, numeric-policy, checkpoint, stimulus, or lower-layer repair is authorized now. Backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, and board runtime remain blocked.
